services.value: The Environmental Biology research program develops and applies methods to detect waterborne pathogens (or indicators) using techniques including culture (plating, enzyme substrate), real-time PCR, digital PCR, MALDI-ToF mass spectrometry, ELISA, and microscopy. It also supports development and validation of molecular and culture-based methods for pathogens and indicator bacteria and for detecting cyanotoxin genes in NYS recreational waters.
